summary.name: Opera
summary.one_liner: Opera is a web browser marketed as faster, safer and smarter than default browsers, with built-in privacy and ad-blocking features.
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Opera as a fully featured web browser focused on privacy, security and speed. It lists tab groups for keeping tabs organized by context. It names built-in features including an ad blocker, a Player, Lucid Mode for distraction-free browsing, and Flow file sharing. The page says Opera has been developed for over 30 years and mentions gaming products as a related offering. Claims about performance and user numbers are marketing statements and are not independently detailed on the page.
caveats: Platform details are not listed on the page text beyond the Mac awesome-list entry
Performance and user-count claims are marketing statements
